THE 50-EMA ON THE HIGHER TIMEFRAMES
The General Guidelines:
Trade in the Direction of the EMA.
4H Bullish Zone, price above the 4H EMA and EMA is sloping up.
1H Bullish zone, price below the 1H EMA and EMA is sloping down.
Consider the Slope of the EMA.
Inclined EMA Slope = Trending Market.
Flat EMA = Consolidating Market.
The EMA is a Dynamic Support/Resistance level.
Look for Bounce plays from it.
Never trade against it when it’s tapped. Wait for it to break and retest.
You can only trade towards it, while it’s not tapped yet (counter-trend trade).
Look for EMA Agreement across timeframes.
If the EMA direction is the same on 2+ timeframes – you have a good bias.
